description: Verify that Subscribe eg 0x02 + trigger triggerEventUINT8 — DUT Ack + MSB-set notification
approach:
[Objective]
Verify the SOME/IP-SD event-subscription path on a DUT that exports eventgroup 0x02 on SERVICE-ID-1. Per PRS_SOMEIPSD, the DUT must (a) announce the service with an IPv4 endpoint option, (b) acknowledge the Tester's SubscribeEventgroup with a Type-7 entry (ttl>0), and (c) deliver the initial Notification on the subscribed eventgroup with the method-ID highest bit set.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Phase 1 (deadline 6s): Tester listens for DUT OfferService (SD entry type=0x01) carrying at least one IPv4 endpoint option on SERVICE-ID-1.
2. Phase 2 (deadline 6s): Tester sends SubscribeEventgroup (eg=0x0002). DUT must reply with SubscribeEventgroupAck (entry type=0x07, ttl>0). A ttl=0 reply is a Nack → Fail_phase2_subscribe_nacked.
3. Phase 3 (deadline 4s): DUT must emit a Notification (message_type=0x02) with method_id MSB set (0x8000) on SERVICE-ID-1 — typically the initialEvent vsomeip pushes on Subscribe.

[Pass condition]
All three transitions fire within the per-phase deadlines.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* as listed in the verdict table.

[Per-packet meaning]
The Note column maps each captured frame to its SCXML phase + spec clause. The Summary column (auto-decoded) shows the SOME/IP-SD entry type, service ID, eventgroup ID, ttl, and (for IPv4 endpoint options) the announced endpoint count.

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked subscribe + emitted notification — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_offer_with_endpoint: No OfferService with IPv4 endpoint within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_no_notification: No notification with event MSB within listen window

messages.label: Phase 1 PASS trigger — DUT OfferService (SD entry type=0x01) for SERVICE-ID-1 with an IPv4 endpoint option. Satisfies listening_phase1 cond (sd_entries[0].type==0x01 ∧ sd_ipv4_endpoint_count>=1) — transitions to listening_phase2. Maps to PRS_SOMEIPSD §OfferService.

Phase 2 PASS trigger — DUT SubscribeEventgroupAck (SD entry type=0x07, ttl>0, eg=0x0002). Satisfies listening_phase2 cond (type==0x07 ∧ ttl>0 ∧ eventgroup_id==expected.eventgroup_id) — transitions to listening_phase3. A ttl=0 reply here would route to fail_phase2_subscribe_nacked. Maps to PRS_SOMEIPSD §SubscribeEventgroupAck.

Phase 3 PASS trigger — DUT Notification on SERVICE-ID-1 with message_type=0x02 and method_id high bit set (initialEvent for TestEventUINT8 = 0x8001). Satisfies listening_phase3 cond (message_type==0x02 ∧ (method_id & 0x8000)==0x8000). Final transition to pass. Maps to PRS_SOMEIPSD §InitialEvent.
